panels.description: Score-threshold populations: connected gossip peers whose score is at or above each configured gate. The gates are cumulative, so the series do not add up; native all counts every connected gossip peer, and its nonnegative gate is the one libp2p labels mesh. Direct peers count by their numeric score, so this is not a count of peers whose RPCs would be accepted.

prioritizePeers duration
panels.description:
Duration of **prioritizePeers()**, the core peer selection/pruning algorithm run each heartbeat.

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_manager_prioritize_peers_seconds`

- Shows **avg**.
- Divide by *Peers evaluated* (panel below) for time-per-peer.
- Split out of total heartbeat duration to attribute cost to this phase.

panels.title: Peer score store update duration
panels.description:
Duration of the peer score store update (exponential decay + prune over every tracked peer) each heartbeat.

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_score_update_seconds`

- Shows **avg**.
- This loop iterates the whole score store, so divide by *score map size* (Map sizes panel) for time-per-peer — **not** by peers evaluated.

panels.title: Peers evaluated per heartbeat
panels.description:
Number of connected healthy peers **prioritizePeers()** evaluated per heartbeat.

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_manager_peers_evaluated_count`

- The denominator for *prioritizePeers duration* time-per-peer.

panels.title: Peer score state transitions (rate / min)
panels.description:
Rate of peer score state crossings (Healthy / Disconnected / Banned), per minute, by transition.

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_score_state_transitions_total`

- Sensitive to the decay formula, thresholds, and gossip-score weighting.

panels.title: Peers pruned (rate / min)
panels.description:
Rate of peers the manager intends to disconnect, per minute, by reason.

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_manager_peers_pruned_total`

- Covers both top-of-heartbeat bad-score disconnects (`banned` / `score_too_low`) and prioritization reasons.
- Counts **intent**, not completion (goodbye is fire-and-forget).

panels.title: Peer relevance checks (rate / min)
panels.description:
Rate of peer relevance checks on Status, per minute, by result.

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_relevance_check_total`

- `result` is `relevant`, an irrelevant reason code (fork digest / clock skew / finalized mismatch / missing earliestAvailableSlot), or `error`.
- Fires on every status evaluation.

panels.title: Peers per active subnet
panels.description:
Connected peer count per active subnet (avg per type).

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_manager_peers_per_active_subnet` (label `type=attnets|syncnets`)

- Checks the min-peers-per-subnet invariant.

panels.title: Outbound peers ratio
panels.description:
Ratio of outbound to total connected healthy peers.

**Metric:** `lodestar_peer_manager_outbound_peers_ratio`

- Verifies the OUTBOUND_PEERS_RATIO floor (~10%, see issue #2215).

panels.title: Peer manager map sizes
panels.description:
Entry counts of peer manager data structures (**not bytes**).

**Metrics:** `lodestar_peer_manager_score_map_size`, `lodestar_peer_manager_connected_peers_map_size`, `libp2p_peers`

- *connected peers map* should track *libp2p_peers*; a persistent gap indicates a connection leak.
- *score map* reflects prune-to-MAX_ENTRIES / SCORE_THRESHOLD retention.
